title: Freezers of UK meat suppliers heat up after cyber-attacks in Europe
summary_full: Cybersecurity experts say incidents had minimal effect but may represent the ‘foothills’ of a wider threatMeat suppliers in the UK have been hit by cyber-attacks after hackers raised the temperatures of supermarket freezers across Europe.The UK’s National Cyber Security Centre said it was working with the affected companies but the national impact was minimal.
